ledger: child | blue zip hoodie, dark hair, standing at wooden table, both hands at glass bowl | same hoodie, framing pushed in so only hands/forearms visible | continuous camera push-in from wide to tight on bowl

glass bowl | ~8-9 glossy spheres: roughly 3 red, 3 yellow, 3 green, neatly settled | crowded with blurred, deformed balls dominated by red, few yellow | right hand begins stirring ~4.75s; content changes thereafter
loose balls on table (right edge) | red/green balls at table edge | out of frame after push-in | leave frame ~4.0s due to camera move
small silver cup with leaf-print item | on table right of bowl | out of frame | leaves frame ~4.25s due to camera move

findings.description: Before stirring the bowl holds ~8-9 balls (about 3 red, 3 yellow, 3 green). Within ~0.5s of the hand starting to stir (5.25-5.75s) the bowl shows only ~5-6 balls (e.g. at 5.75s: 1 green, 2 yellow, 1 green, 1 red) with no balls seen leaving the bowl; balls vanish.

From ~7.5s onward the bowl contains 4-6 red balls with only one or two yellow, whereas it started with ~3 red and ~3 yellow; red balls multiply and yellow ones disappear while nothing is added or removed. Count and color mix keep fluctuating frame to frame through 9.75s.

The hard glossy spheres become lumpy, smeared, pepper/blob-like shapes (e.g. 6.0s, 6.75s, 9.0-9.75s), with stretched streaks and soft edges that read as generative morphing rather than motion blur; spheres should stay round.

At 9.0-9.75s the stirring hand smears into and merges with the balls; fingers dissolve into red/green blobs and a ball appears to pass through the hand, with no clear finger count or contact boundary.

At 9.0-9.25s a flat beige/pinkish panel shape appears at the top edge behind the bowl, between the child's forearms, where previously only blue hoodie and paving were visible; it has no plausible source.

Starting ~5s the stirring region becomes heavily smeared and the overall image loses detail (table grain and hand texture soften) as the camera pushes in, worsening to 9.75s; the end of the clip is not publishable quality.
